article.title: Culture and the Moment
article.author: Sage Crump
article.content: Artists and cultural workers are an integral part of all revolutionary movements across geography and time. From Chinese puppetry, to the harmonies of Sweet Honey in the Rock, to the Místicas of the Landless Workers Movement (MST) in Brazil, culture has added to the canon of what resistance can look like. Living in a time of authoritarianism and proto-fascism means culture has been hijacked. Source
